subject: Procurement & legal sequencing for Crestline MAP: acceptance dependencies and timeline
messages:
From: Michael Thompson <michael.thompson@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@crestlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 02 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement sequencing — draft MAP and dependencies

Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency/cost numbers. We're ready to move toward a pilot, but procurement wants clarity on the exact sequencing before we loop legal. Two specific asks from my side:

1) We need a mutual action plan that shows when the MSA, DPA and order form will be completed relative to the pilot acceptance windows.
2) Outline what evidence (SOC 2 summary, network diagrams, data retention statement) you'll attach to each milestone so procurement can present to our internal committee.

Can you send a proposed timeline (one page) with dependencies? We're targeting the week of Oct 20 for pilot start but that depends on legal review cadence.

—Michael
Michael Thompson
Head of Procurement | Crestline Health
michael.thompson@crestlinehealth.com
procurement@crestlinehealth.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Thompson <michael.thompson@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement sequencing — draft MAP and dependencies

Michael — thanks, this is helpful. Attaching a short MAP sketch and our standard evidence pack. High level plan below; I'll loop in Laura to confirm contract sequencing and Karthik for any obligations on implementation timing.

Proposed high-level sequencing (week numbers):
- Week 1 (Sep 8–12): Redwood sends redlined MSA (v3) + SOC2 summary + network appendix.
- Week 2 (Sep 15–19): Crestline legal reviews MSA redline; Redwood receives comments.
- Week 3 (Sep 22–26): Order form draft finalized (pricing, seat counts) and shared for procurement signoff.
- Week 4 (Sep 29–Oct 3): DPA review in parallel; mutual agreement on data handling and retention.
- Week 7 (Oct 20–24): Pilot kickoff (conditional on signed order form + executed DPA; MSA may be signed in parallel or executed as a post-execution step with committed signature date).

Critical dependencies: MSA redline turnaround (max 7 business days), SOC2 evidence confirmation, order form pricing signoff. If legal needs longer, we can run a limited pilot under an interim mutual action letter — advise if procurement would accept that.

Attachments: MSA_v3_redlined.pdf (redline), SOC2_summary.pdf, orderform_draft_crestline.xlsx (pricing stub).

I'll set up a 30-minute sync this week to align.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Michael Thompson <michael.thompson@crestlinehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Sep 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement sequencing — draft MAP and dependencies

Folks — quick read of the redline I sent back a few comments (high level):

- We should try to preserve our standard termination-for-convenience language in Section 12 but accept a 60-day notice to be reasonable for this account.
- Liability cap: push for 3x fees but be prepared to accept the customer's request if they have a procurement-minimum.
- Order form: include a conditional pilot appendix that permits a scoped pilot upon execution of the order form + DPA, with MSA signature allowed within 10 business days after pilot start. That will give the customer comfort and minimize legal blocking.

Michael — if Crestline can agree to the pilot appendix approach (execute order form + DPA to start pilot; sign MSA within 10 business days), we can hit the Oct 20 target. If not, we should schedule legal-to-legal with Sophia this week to triage specific line items.

I'll attach a one-page process map for the procurement/legal handoff in the HubSpot link for visibility.

Laura Bennett
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Sophia Chan <sophia.chan@crestlinehealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Thompson <michael.thompson@crestlinehealth.com>, procurement@crestlinehealth.com
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2025 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Procurement sequencing — draft MAP and dependencies

On Fri, Sep 5, 2025 at 08:16 AM Sophia Chan <sophia.chan@crestlinehealth.com> wrote:

Laura / Rafael — reviewed the redline. A couple of constraints from our side:

- Crestline cannot sign an order form that starts a pilot unless the DPA is executed or an equivalent data protection addendum is in place. We can accept a short-term Errata / letter that commits to the DPA being signed within 5 business days of pilot start.
- We will push back on a 10-day post-pilot MSA signature window — procurement wants the MSA in place before any service access.

That said, procurement is willing to fast-track reviews if Redwood can give a firm timetable for the MSA edits and accepts a reciprocal limited liability carve-out for the pilot period.

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call on Monday to triage — Michael, Rafael, please propose two time slots.

Regards,
Sophia Chan
General Counsel | Crestline Health
sophia.chan@crestlinehealth.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement sequencing — draft MAP and dependencies

Thanks all — quick recap and ask so we have a single source of truth for the MAP:

1) Agreed path (conditional): Crestline will permit a pilot to start on Oct 20 if we have: executed DPA OR an interim DPA letter executed before pilot start; executed order form that references the pilot appendix; and a signed mutual confidentiality addendum. Crestline indicated a preference to have the MSA signed ahead of service access but agreed to escalate internally to examine exceptions for a tightly-scoped pilot.

2) Redwood commitments: Laura will finalize the pilot appendix (attached to the order form) and provide a one-page liability carve-out for the pilot window. Karthik will assemble the tech evidence pack (SOC2_summary.pdf + network appendix) and make it available to Sophia's team via the Drive link.

3) Timeline (updated):
- Sep 18–22: Legal-to-legal review and finalization of pilot appendix + DPA letter.
- Sep 23–26: Procurement approves order form pricing and signs order form.
- Oct 6–10: Final signatures (ideally MSA + DPA); fallback: sign order form + DPA letter to allow pilot access.
- Oct 20: Pilot start (conditional).

Action: Michael — can your team commit to the internal escalation this week so we have a definitive stance on MSA-before-access vs. pilot-appendix exception? Laura will share the draft appendix by end of day Friday.

Attachments: (referenced in prior mail) MSA_v3_redlined.pdf; SOC2_summary.pdf; orderform_draft_crestline.xlsx

Cheers,
